explicitRisk: Minimum risk that needs explicit authorization
policyDescription: normal and strict share one base policy; progress uses the extra conditions on the right. The thresholds are not calibrated and are adjustable starting values.
bulkEgress: progress allows ordinary bulk egress with explicit authorization (R6)
argumentMax: Truncated characters of historical tool arguments
customRules: CUSTOM_RULES (global review guidance, at most 2000 characters)
breakerHelpTripped: Trips circuit breaker protection when {consecutive} consecutive operations are denied, or when denials reach {windowDenials} within 30 minutes, pausing auto-approvals.
breakerHelpOff: Circuit breaker protection is disabled; repeated denials will not trip automated gating.
auditDescription: An audit write failure does not change the permission outcome. Log cleanup deletes only the SQLite audit, not the DSH session verdict records.
